elements.title: Pablo Busch (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a bandit spared the life of physician Pablo Busch (pictured) because "he treated the poor for free"?

elements.title: Palaeotherium (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that a skull of the distant horse relative Palaeotherium was first misidentified as an amphibian, then as a canine?

elements.title: Nikolaus Mollyn (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Nikolaus Mollyn was the first book printer in Riga, and the first to print a book in Latvian within the present-day territory of Latvia?

elements.title: Nazi crimes against children (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that in addition to millions murdered, Nazi crimes against children included compulsory sterilization, forced labor, forced institutionalization, medical experiments and Germanisation?

elements.title: eleven different managers over ten seasons (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Chivas USA had eleven different managers over ten seasons?

elements.title: Qian Xingcun (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that literary critic Qian Xingcun brought several Communist writers into the Shanghai film industry?

elements.title: Nazareth Hall Preparatory Seminary (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that the clergy of the Archdiocese of Saint Paul and Minneapolis were upset about the sale of Nazareth Hall Preparatory Seminary after its closure?

elements.title: women's 400 metres at the 2023 European Athletics Indoor Championships (Wikipedia — did you know?)
elements.contents: ... that Femke Bol successfully defended her 2021 title by winning the women's 400 metres at the 2023 European Athletics Indoor Championships?

elements.title: Louis Abramson (Wikipedia — did you know?)
